name: PD · Alerts
description: PD stage: records new findings in Postgres pd_findings (dedupe by key), posts one Discord summary per run and a separate @here message for new silent-fix candidates.

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pd_findings (
  key text PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id text NOT NULL,
  product text NOT NULL,
  old_version text,
  new_version text,
  kind text,
  location text,
  score numeric,
  signals jsonb,
  advisory_match text,
  silent_fix boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  llm_bug_class text,
  llm_summary text,
  llm_confidence text,
  llm_likely_security_fix int,
  llm_entry_point text,
  artefact_path text,
  first_seen timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  alerted_at timestamptz
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pd_findings_product_idx ON pd_findings (product, new_version);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pd_findings_silent_idx ON pd_findings (first_seen) WHERE silent_fix;

parameters.command:
=R='{{ $('When Called').first().json.run_dir }}'
case "$R" in /opt/loot/patchdiff/*/2*Z-*) ;; *) echo 'bad run dir' >&2; exit 1;; esac
F="$R/triage/triaged.json"
[ -s "$F" ] || F="$R/advisory/candidates.json"
[ -s "$F" ] || F="$R/diff/candidates.json"
if [ -s "$F" ]; then
  jq -c '[.[:25][] | {key, kind, location, score, rank, signals: (.signals.hits // {}), advisory_match, llm_bug_class, llm_likely_security_fix, llm_summary, llm_confidence, llm_entry_point}]' "$F"
else
  echo '[]'
fi

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO pd_findings AS f (key, run_id, product, old_version, new_version, kind, location, score, signals, advisory_match, silent_fix, llm_bug_class, llm_summary, llm_confidence, llm_likely_security_fix, llm_entry_point, artefact_path)
SELECT r.key, r.run_id, r.product, r.old_version, r.new_version, r.kind, r.location, r.score, r.signals, r.advisory_match, r.silent_fix, r.llm_bug_class, r.llm_summary, r.llm_confidence, r.llm_likely_security_fix, r.llm_entry_point, r.artefact_path
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(key text, run_id text, product text, old_version text, new_version text, kind text, location text, score numeric, signals jsonb, advisory_match text, silent_fix boolean, llm_bug_class text, llm_summary text, llm_confidence text, llm_likely_security_fix int, llm_entry_point text, artefact_path text)
ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING key;

nodeGroups.name: Record and dedupe
nodeGroups.description: pd_findings in Postgres keyed by stable hash; only keys not seen before count as new. silent_fix = LLM >= threshold and no advisory.

nodeGroups.name: Discord
nodeGroups.description: One summary per run (top 5) to #n8n-alerts, plus a separate @here message for new silent-fix candidates.
